scripts.dev: bun run dev:server & bun run dev:client
scripts.dev:client: cd client && portless run --name raceiq bun vite
scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && rm -rf dist/* && cd client && bun install && bun vite build && cd .. && bun scripts/copy-shared-data.ts && cp -r client/dist dist/public && NODE_ENV=production bun build --compile server/index.ts --outfile dist/forza-telemetry
